    FD-Backed Credit Card

    A credit card backed by your Fixed Deposit.

    Put your FD to work twice. Get a high-limit credit card secured against your deposit — while the FD keeps earning interest. No income proof, near-guaranteed approval.

    Get the card → Book a new FD first
    Why it's different

    Your money works two ways at once.

    • ✓FD keeps earning — your deposit continues to accrue interest while it secures your card.
    • ✓High approval odds — secured against your FD, so no income proof or credit history required.
    • ✓Generous limit — a credit limit of up to a high percentage of your FD value.
    • ✓Build your credit score — spend responsibly and grow your credit profile from day one.
    How it works

    Three steps to a secured card.

    Book a new FD

    Open a Fixed Deposit with a partner bank through Stable Money — it becomes the security for your card.

    Apply for the card

    Request the FD-backed card against your deposit. No income documents, minimal checks.

    Spend & earn

    Use your card while your FD keeps earning interest, and build your credit score as you go.

    Disclaimer: The FD-Backed Credit Card is issued by a partner Bank / NBFC and is subject to their eligibility criteria, terms and conditions. Credit limit is determined by the issuer as a proportion of the underlying Fixed Deposit. Fixed Deposits are subject to the partner bank's terms; premature closure may affect the card. Images are for representation purposes only.

    Common questions

    Everything you might ask.

    Yes. Stable Money never holds your funds — they go directly to RBI-regulated partner banks, where deposits are insured up to ₹5 Lakh per bank, per PAN by DICGC (a wholly-owned subsidiary of the RBI). This is the same protection you get at any nationalised bank.

    The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) insures bank deposits up to ₹5 Lakh per depositor, per bank. It's backed by the RBI, so your deposit carries the same guarantee whether it's at a large private bank or one of our Small Finance Bank partners.

    No. You book from your existing bank account using just your PAN. There's no new account to open and no branch visit — the whole process is paperless and takes about two minutes.

    Stable Money is operated by Stable-Alpha Technologies Private Limited and is backed by leaders including Nandan Nilekani, Kunal Bahl and Sriharsha Majety. The platform is ISO 27001:2022 certified and SEBI-registered as a Research Analyst (INH000024912).
